description: Unit test source file for the TextFragment and TextSegmentIterator classes in the core module of the project. It verifies string manipulation, iteration, and comparison functionalities.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: Represents a segment or fragment of text, supporting trimming, comparison, and searching functionalities.

classes.name: TextSegmentIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing text segments within a TextFragment.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next text segment.

methods.name: Remainder
methods.description: Returns the remaining part of the text after the current position.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current text fragment the iterator points to.

methods.name: ForwardFind
methods.description: Finds the position of a delimiter or substring in the text.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the TextFragment to an empty state.

methods.name: OnMarker
methods.description: Checks if the text fragment contains a specific marker or substring.

methods.name: EqualText
methods.description: Compares the TextFragment's text with external text.

methods.name: TrimBegin
methods.description: Trims the specified prefix from the TextFragment if present.

methods.name: TrimEnd
methods.description: Trims the specified suffix from the TextFragment if present.

methods.name: ReverseFind
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a substring within the text fragment.

methods.name: ReverseSkip
methods.description: Skips backwards over a specified substring.
